result.analyst_notes: Mostly factual and historical: a long timeline of past inventions dominates, with little stated values. Opens with an absolute, first-person-plural claim that IBM makes the world work better. Clients are addressed first and most often. Sustainability is framed as a goal, and most other commitments are brief teasers or links.
